head.text: Branch Predictor — direction misprediction, EX2 redirect (stage 7e: IF/ID/RR/EX1/EX2)

foot.text: EX1 folds bpred_dir_mispredict into ex1_ex2_q; EX2 reads it combinationally and forms ex_redirect_d, flushing if_id_q/id_rr_q/rr_ex1_q/ex1_ex2_q (the wrong-path follower) and redirecting IF to the resolved target T (§6). Measured at stage 7e (bench_mispredict vs bench_taken_branch, §11): a misprediction costs 15 cycles/branch against 12 for a correctly-predicted taken branch — 3 cycles more, not the simple single-bubble picture a 5-stage pipeline would suggest.
